public_delta.note: Two existing-handle Form methods distinguish detached native creation data from exact UI restoration. One narrow private native record/parser builder has actual Form/Grid callers; no public helper/type/option/module, business dataset or registry is added. Grid default path-conflict and recursion fixes are explicit selected outcomes.
public_delta.shared_module_visibility: One private shared module; the private-module count names that same module, not a second addition.

capture_and_creation.outcome: Capture live native creation values and separate UI restoration metadata once after preflight and before local format/render. Return detached native-only defaults including readonly/disabled fields, nested paths and stable group/Select shapes, authored raw mappings for marked choices and first filename for files. Exclude static/image fields, unbound business keys, option-source lists and private File references. Do not recapture on bind/refresh/reset/revert.
capture_and_creation.remaining: The application factory supplies full T and received status. Native defaults, live captured restoration and Rows originals remain distinct; general schema/source/dynamic equivalence is not closed.

shared_native_builder.outcome: Share actual native record/parser assembly with Grid while retaining caller-owned capture/lifecycles. Form uses applicable own parsers against one complete unparsed record with null rowId/authored element. Preserve Grid capture eligibility, text parser eligibility/order, error codes, contexts and active checks; Select fields do not acquire Grid text parsers. Both owners reject duplicate and parent/child paths in either order before parsing, undefined/async/uncloneable results and per-owner recursive getter entry, drain rejected promises and release guards for recovery.
shared_native_builder.remaining: Only the documented Grid silent-overwrite and getter recursion defects are corrected. Broader Grid family/default/source and shared/global lifecycle equivalence remain required.

detach_and_restore.outcome: Preflight file reconstruction before invalidating generation or changing reset/association/DOM state. Unbind drops the current Rows association and only its invalid draft, clears owned pointer/projection/visible errors/reset work and sets Rows change flags false, while preserving unrelated drafts and every source snapshot/status/original/change/subscription. Keep root/Select/error/ARIA ownership reusable; local field-change markers remain application-owned. Restoration invokes no parser, formatter, renderer, whole/value hook or Rows notification itself.
detach_and_restore.remaining: Unbind is not a business-data reset, removal, disposal or received checkpoint operation; applications keep caller-held RowId/Rows for full source access.

native_and_static_ownership.outcome: Restore native values/checkedness and Select selection by captured option identity/occurrence. Marked Selects reuse owned authored nodes/raw maps and discard generated-source state; unmarked option structure stays application-owned and only surviving captured selections are restored. Restore exact authored static/custom child nodes and exact absent/empty/relative image src while leaving alt and native defaults/disabled/readOnly configuration unchanged.
native_and_static_ownership.remaining: Dynamic markup/configuration reconciliation remains required later work. Normal disposal keeps its existing latest-local-raw/Rows-custom-child semantics and releases captured metadata/File references.

files_inactive_and_reentry.outcome: Retain initial local File references privately, reconstruct native FileList through DataTransfer and assign files rather than nonempty filename; empty capture clears natively. Unsupported reconstruction fails FORM_UNBIND with field/cause before state changes. After local unbind, automatic input/change/focus/pointer/reset work stays inactive; read/validate remain explicit, selected refresh is display-only and full bind(null)/refresh resumes. A per-owner restoring flag covers preflight/writes and releases in finally; entry/new generation and disposal checks stop later stale writes while active callback/renderer guards remain intact.
files_inactive_and_reentry.remaining: Rows-backed/multiple-file restrictions remain unchanged. Native reset default action and already executing application setters/callback effects are not transactional; no generic restore/store engine is introduced.

migration_and_installed.outcome: Exercise a real CVC search restore action and explicit application creation factory using captured native values. Use one exact tar in isolated JS/TS and all five available Windows browsers for public signatures, captured creation values, restored native files and exact children, retained Rows/ownership, inactive/resume behavior and disposed-method errors. Source-browser regressions separately exercise reconstruction failure, callback supersession and reentry guards. Require complete fresh three-engine coverage and unchanged original performance budgets.
migration_and_installed.remaining: No full family or historical runtime closure, omission, npm publication or tag follows; actual macOS/iOS Safari remains excluded.
